create_multiagent_wrapper: create a MultiAgentWrapper to treat a single-agent gym environment as multi-agent with 1 agent
check_is_multiagent_env: check if a gym environment is multi-agent by calling is_multiagent_env with the env object
reset_multiagent_wrapper: reset the MultiAgentWrapper environment and receive a list containing a single observation
step_multiagent_wrapper: step the MultiAgentWrapper with a list action and receive list-wrapped obs, reward, done, and info
review_multiagent_wrapper_class: review the MultiAgentWrapper class to understand how single-agent data is converted into lists of length 1
